In the foreground, the young girl in a red gi (R3) sits cross-legged on the left, and the young girl in a white gi (R4) sits cross-legged on the right, both with their backs to the camera as they watch attentively. In the background, the bearded instructor with a headband (R6) wearing a black gi stands facing them, gesturing with his hand near his face as he speaks. Soft daylight illuminates the warm-toned room.
